###deimos_expertmode
# @name: Couch Potato 69 - 10 Row (3,6,8,8,10,10,8,8,6,2)
# @zone: Housing
# @author: generated by tools/gen_garden_bot.py
# @format: expertmode
# @description: Builds 69 soil plots. Logs every step to the Deimos log file.
#
# SETUP: soil in favorites slot 1, absolute movement + sensitivity 20, rug placed
# where the layout starts, no gardening/housing popups open. Do not touch anything while it runs.

setvar PlaceDelay = 1.0     # after clicking to place soil
setvar PickDelay = 0.4      # after picking the soil icon
setvar NudgeDelay = 0.15    # between arrow clicks
setvar ModeDelay = 0.4      # after G/H/window opens
setvar HousingSettle = 1.5  # wait after H before clicking the rug (camera may still be moving)
setvar ReselectRug = 1      # 1 = click the world to select the rug before advanced move
setvar DoExtras = 1         # 1 = sky stack at the garden center: king parsley plot (favorites slot 2) + items

block wait_world {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: WorldView not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_icon1 {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'GardeningWindow', 'GardeningSubWindow', 'BottomFrame', 'Icon1'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'GardeningWindow', 'GardeningSubWindow', 'BottomFrame', 'Icon1'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: soil icon Icon1 (gardening window) not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_icon2 {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'GardeningWindow', 'GardeningSubWindow', 'BottomFrame', 'Icon2'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'GardeningWindow', 'GardeningSubWindow', 'BottomFrame', 'Icon2'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: soil icon Icon2 (gardening window) not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_bottom {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'ObjectPlacementWindow', 'ObjectPlacementBottom', 'ObjectPlacementSubWindow', 'BottomFrame'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'ObjectPlacementWindow', 'ObjectPlacementBottom', 'ObjectPlacementSubWindow', 'BottomFrame'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: housing placement bar (ObjectPlacementBottom BottomFrame) not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_adv {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: AdvancedMoveObjectButton (rug not selected?) not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_accept {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: advanced movement AcceptButton not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_accept_gone {
    times 40 {
        if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: advanced movement window to close still visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_btn_L {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveLeftButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveLeftButton'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: movement button MoveLeftButton not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_btn_R {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveRightButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveRightButton'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: movement button MoveRightButton not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_btn_U {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveBackwardButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveBackwardButton'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: movement button MoveBackwardButton not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_btn_ZU {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveUpButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveUpButton'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: movement button MoveUpButton not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}
block wait_btn_ZD {
    times 40 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveDownButton'] {
            break
        }
        sleep 0.25
    }
    if not any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveDownButton'] {
        log '[B] ERROR: movement button MoveDownButton not visible after 10s - stopping. Last step logged above shows where'
        kill
    }
}

log '[B] === Couch Potato 69 - 10 Row (3,6,8,8,10,10,8,8,6,2) ==='
log '[B] plan: 69 plots, starting at plot 1, click mode rug entity HOUSE_PA_RedGoldRug'
log '[B] sky stack above plot 30 (x=-2 y=16): king parsley at 12, then items every 4 clicks: none'
log '[B] WARNING: Sandwich Station has no icon in garden_items.json - place it manually near the center'
log '[B] WARNING: Topiary Garden Gnome has no icon in garden_items.json - place it manually near the center'
log '[B] WARNING: Litter has no icon in garden_items.json - place it manually near the center'
log '[B] preflight: checking WorldView and energy'
call wait_world
log energy
if mass energy < 69 {
    log '[B] ERROR: need at least 69 energy for the remaining plots - stopping'
    kill
}
starttimer total_run

starttimer plot_1
log '[B] plot 1/69 (row 1/10 col 1/3 x=-4 y=0) START'
log energy
log '[B]   plot 1/69 (row 1/10 col 1/3 x=-4 y=0): gardening mode (G)'
mass sendkey G, 0.1
sleep $ModeDelay
call wait_icon1
log '[B]   plot 1/69 (row 1/10 col 1/3 x=-4 y=0): select soil icon'
mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'GardeningWindow', 'GardeningSubWindow', 'BottomFrame', 'Icon1']
sleep $PickDelay
log '[B]   plot 1/69 (row 1/10 col 1/3 x=-4 y=0): place soil on rug'
mass clickentity 'HOUSE_PA_RedGoldRug@soilfirst'
sleep $PlaceDelay
log energy
log '[B]   plot 1/69 (row 1/10 col 1/3 x=-4 y=0): housing mode (H)'
mass sendkey H, 0.1
call wait_bottom
sleep $ModeDelay
log '[B]   plot 1 -> 2: select rug (ReselectRug flag), open advanced movement'
if ReselectRug = 1 {
    sleep $HousingSettle
    times 4 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton'] {
            if windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText'] contains 'golden blossom' {
                break
            }
        }
        mass clickentity 'HOUSE_PA_RedGoldRug@rim'
        sleep 0.8
    }
}
call wait_adv
log '[B]   plot 1 -> 2: selected object name follows (should be the rug)'
log windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText']
if windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText'] contains 'golden blossom' {
    log '[B]   plot 1 -> 2: rug selected'
} else {
    log '[B] ERROR: plot 1 -> 2: the rug is not the selected object after 4 clicks - stopping'
    kill
}
mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton']
sleep $ModeDelay
call wait_accept
log '[B]   plot 1 -> 2: move RIGHT (4 clicks)'
call wait_btn_R
times 4 {
    mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveRightButton']
    sleep $NudgeDelay
}
log '[B]   plot 1 -> 2: accept move'
mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton']
call wait_accept_gone
sleep $ModeDelay
endtimer plot_1
log '[B] plot 1/69 DONE'

if ReselectRug = 1 {
    sleep $HousingSettle
    times 4 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton'] {
            if windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText'] contains 'golden blossom' {
                break
            }
        }
        mass clickentity 'HOUSE_PA_RedGoldRug@rim'
        sleep 0.8
    }
}
call wait_adv
log '[B]   plot 39 -> 40: selected object name follows (should be the rug)'
log windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText']
if windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText'] contains 'golden blossom' {
    log '[B]   plot 39 -> 40: rug selected'
} else {
    log '[B] ERROR: plot 39 -> 40: the rug is not the selected object after 4 clicks - stopping'
    kill
}
mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton']
sleep $ModeDelay
call wait_accept

call wait_btn_L
times 4 {
    mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveLeftButton']
    sleep $NudgeDelay
}
log '[B]   plot 39 -> 40: accept move'
mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton']
call wait_accept_gone
sleep $ModeDelay

log '[B]   plot 60 -> 61: select rug (ReselectRug flag), open advanced movement'
if ReselectRug = 1 {
    sleep $HousingSettle
    times 4 {
        if any windowvisible ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton'] {
            if windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText'] contains 'golden blossom' {
                break
            }
        }
        mass clickentity 'HOUSE_PA_RedGoldRug@rim'
        sleep 0.8
    }
}
call wait_adv
log '[B]   plot 60 -> 61: selected object name follows (should be the rug)'
log windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText']
if windowtext ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'ItemNameText'] contains 'golden blossom' {
    log '[B]   plot 60 -> 61: rug selected'
} else {
    log '[B] ERROR: plot 60 -> 61: the rug is not the selected object after 4 clicks - stopping'
    kill
}
mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'LayoutWindow', 'AdvancedMoveObjectButton']
sleep $ModeDelay
call wait_accept
log '[B]   plot 60 -> 61: move LEFT (4 clicks)'
call wait_btn_L
times 4 {
    mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MovementWindow', 'MoveLeftButton']
    sleep $NudgeDelay
}
log '[B]   plot 60 -> 61: accept move'
mass clickwindow ['WorldView', 'windowHUD', 'AdvancedHousingWindow', 'MainWindow', 'AcceptButton']
call wait_accept_gone
sleep $ModeDelay
endtimer plot_60
